sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2025
sources.text: While underway, five perpetrators were sighted in the engine room. The general alarm was raised and the crew mustered to conduct a search onboard, with no perpetrators found. The crew was not injured. Nothing was stolen. The incident was reported to Singapore POCC. Safety broadcasts on anti-piracy watch were initiated to warn all vessels to maintain a vigilant watch at all times in the SS. The RSN’s MSTF and Singapore PCG were notified of the incident. Information of the incident was shared with the Indonesian authority.
